table inet t {
	counter cnt {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	quota q {
		over 10 mbytes
	}

	limit lim {
		rate 5/second
	}

	limit limover {
		rate over 5/second
	}

	ct helper ftp-std {
		type "ftp" protocol tcp
		l3proto inet
	}

	set ty {
		typeof ip saddr . tcp dport
		elements = { 198.51.100.7 . 22 }
	}

	set tmo {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65535	# count 2
		flags timeout
		elements = { 198.51.100.9 timeout 1h expires 59m58s971ms,
			     198.51.100.10 }
	}

	set cmt {
		type ipv4_addr
		counter
		elements = { 198.51.100.11 counter packets 0 bytes 0 comment "one",
			     198.51.100.12 counter packets 0 bytes 0 }
	}

	set macs {
		type ether_addr
		elements = { 00:00:5e:00:53:01 }
	}

	set marks {
		type mark
		elements = { 0x00000001, 0x00000002 }
	}

	set states {
		type ct_state
		elements = { established, related }
	}

	set protos {
		type inet_proto
		elements = { tcp, udp, gre }
	}

	set ifwild {
		type ifname
		flags interval
		elements = { "eth*",
			     "lo" }
	}

	set auto {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { 192.0.2.0/24, 203.0.113.5 }
	}

	set empty {
		type ipv6_addr
	}

	set net6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 2001:db8:1::1-2001:db8:1::ff,
			     2001:db8:99::/64 }
	}

	map vcatch {
		type inet_service : verdict
		elements = { 22 : accept,
			     * : drop }
	}

	map vif {
		type ifname : verdict
		elements = { "docker0" : accept,
			     "eth0" : jump side }
	}

	map vconcat {
		type ipv4_addr . inet_service : verdict
		flags interval
		elements = { 198.51.100.0/24 . 22 : accept,
			     192.0.2.7 . 80-90 : drop }
	}

	map dmap {
		type inet_service : ipv4_addr . inet_service
		elements = { 80 : 172.17.0.2 . 8080 }
	}

	map markmap {
		type ipv4_addr : mark
		elements = { 198.51.100.7 : 0x00000007 }
	}

	flowtable ft {
		hook ingress priority filter
		devices = { "lo" }
	}

	chain side {
	}

	chain in {
		type filter hook input priority filter + 10; policy accept;
		ct state != new accept
		ct state { established, related } accept
		ct state != { established, related } drop
		ct state @states accept
		ct state new,untracked accept
		ct state { new, untracked } accept
		ct status ! dnat accept
		ct status != dnat accept
		ct status snat accept
		ct status snat,dnat accept
		meta ipsec exists accept
		meta ipsec missing accept
		ct helper "ftp" accept
		ct helper set "ftp-std"
		counter name "cnt"
		quota name "q" drop
		quota over 10 mbytes drop
		quota 10 mbytes accept
		limit name "lim" accept
		limit name "limover" drop
		limit rate 10 mbytes/second accept
		tcp dport 5000 queue to 1
		tcp dport 5003 synproxy mss 1460 wscale 7
		meta priority set 1:2
		ct original ip daddr 203.0.113.10 accept
		ct original ip6 daddr 2001:db8::1 accept
		ct reply ip saddr 172.17.0.2 accept
		ct original proto-dst { 80, 443 } accept
		ct zone 5 accept
		ct label 1 accept
		ct expiration 10s accept
		ct l3proto ipv4 accept
		ct protocol tcp accept
		ct mark & 0x000000ff == 0x00000010 accept
		ct mark != 0x00000005 accept
		ct direction reply accept
		ct packets > 10 accept
		rt type 0 drop
		socket transparent 1 accept
		osf name "Linux" accept
		exthdr frag exists drop
		tcp option maxseg size 1400 accept
		tcp option sack-perm exists accept
		ipsec in reqid 1 accept
		iifgroup 1 accept
		meta hour "08:00"-"17:00" accept
		meta day "Saturday" accept
		icmp code 3 accept
		icmp type { echo-reply, echo-request } accept
		icmp type != echo-request accept
		icmp type 200 accept
		icmpv6 type echo-request accept
		icmpv6 code 1 accept
		ip6 nexthdr tcp accept
		ip protocol { tcp, udp } accept
		ip protocol != { tcp, udp } accept
		ip saddr != { 198.51.100.7, 198.51.100.8 } accept
		ether saddr 00:00:5e:00:53:01 accept
		ether saddr @macs accept
		vlan id 5 accept
		meta protocol ip accept
		meta protocol ip6 tcp dport 22 accept
		meta protocol { ip, ip6 } accept
		meta nfproto ipv6 accept
		meta nfproto { ipv4, ipv6 } accept
		meta nfproto != ipv4 accept
		tcp flags & (syn | ack) == syn | ack accept
		tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst | ack) == syn accept
		tcp flags != syn accept
		tcp flags { syn, ack } accept
		tcp flags syn,ack accept
		tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst | ack) != syn drop
		reject with icmpv6 addr-unreachable
		reject with icmp net-unreachable
		reject with icmpx host-unreachable
		reject with icmp admin-prohibited
		log
		log prefix "x" flags all
		log group 2 snaplen 64
		ct count 5 accept
		ct count over 5 reject
		update @tmo { ip saddr timeout 10s }
		delete @tmo { ip saddr }
		add @tmo { ip saddr timeout 10s } counter packets 0 bytes 0
		ip saddr @tmo drop
		ip saddr @cmt drop
		ip saddr @auto accept
		ip6 saddr @empty accept
		ip6 saddr @net6 accept
		ip saddr . tcp dport @ty accept
		meta mark @marks accept
		meta l4proto @protos accept
		iifname @ifwild accept
		tcp dport vmap @vcatch
		iifname vmap @vif
		ip saddr . tcp dport vmap @vconcat
		iifname vmap { "eth0" : jump side, "lo" : accept }
		meta l4proto . th dport vmap { tcp . 22 : accept, udp . 53 : accept }
		ip saddr vmap { 192.0.2.1-192.0.2.9 : drop, 198.51.100.0/24 : accept }
		meta mark vmap { 0x00000001 : accept }
		meta nfproto vmap { ipv4 : jump side, ipv6 : jump side }
		ip protocol vmap { tcp : jump side, udp : jump side }
		meta l4proto vmap { tcp : jump side, udp : continue }
		tcp dport vmap { 22 : accept, 23 : continue, 24 : return }
		continue
		ip saddr 198.51.100.7 counter packets 5 bytes 300 accept
		iif "lo" accept
		oif "lo" accept
		iif != "lo" tcp dport 6000 accept
		iif "lo" accept
		iifname != { "eth0", "eth1" } drop
		meta iiftype loopback accept
		fib saddr type local accept
		fib daddr . iif type local accept
		fib daddr type { local, broadcast } accept
		fib daddr type != local drop
		fib saddr . iif check missing drop
		fib saddr . iif check exists accept
		fib saddr . mark . iif check missing drop
		fib saddr oif "lo" accept
		fib saddr . iif check exists accept
		meta pkttype { broadcast, multicast } drop
		meta pkttype != host drop
		meta pkttype other drop
		ip saddr 198.51.100.7 ip daddr { 203.0.113.10, 203.0.113.11 } tcp sport != 1-1023 accept
		ip6 daddr fe80::/64 udp dport 546 accept
		ip6 saddr != 2001:db8::/32 drop
		ip6 saddr { 2001:db8:98::/48, 2001:db8:99::7 } accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:db8::1-2001:db8::9 accept
		sctp dport 100 accept
		udplite dport 100 accept
		dccp dport 100 accept
		th sport 53 accept
		th dport { 53, 80-90 } accept
		meta l4proto != tcp accept
		meta l4proto gre accept
		meta l4proto { gre, esp, ah } accept
		ip ttl 1 drop
		ip length > 1000 drop
		ip6 hoplimit 255 accept
		ip frag-off & 0x1fff != 0x0 drop
		ip version 4 accept
		tcp window 0 drop
		udp length 8 drop
		meta length 40-60 accept
		tcp dport > 1024 accept
		tcp dport >= 1024 accept
		tcp dport < 1024 accept
		tcp dport <= 1024 accept
		ip saddr > 198.51.100.7 accept
		meta mark > 0x00000005 accept
		tcp dport 22 tcp sport 1024-65535 ct state new limit rate 3/minute burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "ssh rate limited"
		meta nftrace set 1 tcp dport 22 accept
		meta random < 100 accept
		numgen random mod 2 0 accept
		meta cpu 0 accept
		th dport 22 accept
		@nh,0,8 & 0xf0 == 0x40 accept
		ct event set new
		notrack
		jump side
		tcp dport 7000 goto side
		return
		drop
	}

	chain pre {
		type filter hook prerouting priority mangle; policy accept;
		tcp dport 5002 tproxy to :50080
		meta l4proto tcp tproxy ip to 203.0.113.10:50080
		ct zone set 5
		meta mark set ip saddr map @markmap
		meta mark set tcp dport map { 22 : 0x00000001, 80 : 0x00000002 }
		meta mark set 0x00000005 accept
		meta mark set meta mark & 0x000000ff
		meta mark set meta mark ^ 0x00000001
		meta mark set meta mark & 0xffff0012 | 0x00000012
		meta mark set meta mark & 0xffff0012 | 0x00000012
		meta mark set ct mark & 0x000000ff
		ct mark set meta mark & 0x000000ff
		ct mark set ct mark | 0x00000010
		meta mark set numgen inc mod 2
		meta mark set jhash ip saddr mod 2
		meta mark set meta mark & 0xffffff00 | iif
	}

	chain natpre {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		dnat ip to ip daddr map { 203.0.113.10 : 172.17.0.2 }
		dnat ip to tcp dport map { 80 : 172.17.0.2, 443 : 172.17.0.3 }
		dnat ip to tcp dport map @dmap
		dnat ip to tcp dport map { 80 : 172.17.0.2 . 8080 }
		dnat ip to numgen inc mod 2 map { 0 : 172.17.0.2, 1 : 172.17.0.3 }
		tcp dport 81 dnat ip to 172.17.0.2:8080 persistent
		tcp dport 82 dnat ip to 172.17.0.2:8080 random
		tcp dport 83 dnat ip6 to 2001:db8::5
		tcp dport 85 dnat ip to 172.17.0.0/24
		tcp dport 86 redirect to :8080-8090
		redirect to :tcp dport map { 80 : 8080 }
		ip daddr 203.0.113.10 tcp dport 87 dnat ip to 172.17.0.2:80
	}

	chain natpost {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		snat ip to 203.0.113.10-203.0.113.12
		masquerade random
		oifname "eth0" snat ip prefix to ip saddr map { 172.17.0.0/16 : 203.0.113.0/24 }
	}

	chain fwd0 {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy accept;
		tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size set rt mtu
		tcp flags & (syn | rst) == syn tcp option maxseg size set 1400
		ip protocol { tcp, udp } flow add @ft
		meta l4proto tcp flow add @ft
	}

	chain out {
		type route hook output priority mangle; policy accept;
		meta skuid 0 accept
		meta cgroup 1 accept
	}

	chain ing {
		type filter hook ingress device "lo" priority filter; policy accept;
		ip saddr 198.51.100.7 drop
	}
}
table netdev nd {
	chain ingress0 {
		type filter hook ingress device "lo" priority filter; policy accept;
		ip saddr 198.51.100.7 drop
	}

	chain egress0 {
		type filter hook egress device "lo" priority filter; policy accept;
	}
}
table bridge br {
	chain fw {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy accept;
		ip saddr 198.51.100.7 drop
	}
}
table arp ar {
	chain inp {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		arp operation request accept
	}
}
table ip dormant {
	flags dormant

	chain c {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		tcp dport 22 accept
		reject
		reject
		icmp type echo-request accept
		ip protocol tcp accept
		meta l4proto udp accept
	}
}
table ip6 six {
	chain in6 {
		type filter hook input priority filter - 5; policy drop;
		tcp dport 22 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:db8:99::/64 udp dport 53 accept
		meta l4proto ipv6-icmp accept
		icmpv6 type { nd-router-advert, nd-neighbor-solicit } accept
		reject
		reject
	}
}
